summary.source: Fresh Session 85 live-code and live-origin audit after synchronizing main to f2fda328. Premises were checked against the current workflow definitions, performance scripts, status contracts, GitHub Actions history, stable staging and production _health receipts, and the existing 1,094-test source-bound suite. The audit deliberately rejects already-shipped gameplay systems and focuses on three evidence failures that currently let a public candidate outrun staging and leave local release truth stale.
summary.qualityBar: L2 by default: preserve launchReady false, keep the direct game-shell diagnostic distinct from the canonical public-entry performance gate, require an exact immutable candidate on stable staging before production promotion, and make every authority claim reproducible from live revision/artifact evidence. Any touched browser state receives dark/light desktop/mobile rendered inspection.

profile.rubric: product rubric plus game-medium overlay and app-release-gate: first-run player clarity, mobile/theme parity, static-host safety, exact staging identity, rollback, dual-audience contracts, privacy, and honest launch holds
profile.staging: stable Cloudflare Pages must prove the exact immutable candidate before direct-to-main publication; production promotion must be an explicit, candidate-bound action rather than an automatic side effect of any main push
profile.source: arc-profile registry authority, Session 85 startup brief, 29,980-token code sample, targeted reads of public/app.js, tutorialCampaign.js, performance/release scripts, deploy workflows and tests, GitHub Actions runs, and live staging/production health receipts

gameLoopReview.evidence: No new measured player cohort exists. The audit does not invent fun or retention data; it protects the first-run Opening Contract experience and release fidelity while the real opt-in cohort remains pending.

recommendedMoves: Turn the retained first-run game-shell red into a reproducible route-specific probe, then remove the tutorial module waterfall without breaking the lazy-island contract and prove the S84 layout reservation in real pixels.

Stop publishing production as an automatic side effect of every matching main push. Require an explicit candidate-bound promotion whose source revision and artifact already pass stable staging provenance.

Make stale release authority impossible to overlook: compare checked-in staging/performance/release identities with live staging, live production and current Git before doctor or closeout can describe them as current.

items.title: Make the Opening Contract performance fix measurable and remove its avoidable module waterfall
items.premise: Session 84 declared the tutorial layout-shift fix shipped but explicitly deferred live remeasurement. The committed measure-hosted-performance.mjs now hardcodes the canonical public entry route `/`, while GAME_SHELL_DIAGNOSTIC.json was produced by the prior version targeting `game.html`; there is no current command that can reproduce that diagnostic. In public/app.js, tutorialCampaign.js and betaFeedback.js are not requested until after loadCoreDashboard and startup hydration are awaited, creating an avoidable serial waterfall before the first-run tutorial body can become the Largest Contentful Paint element.
evidence: scripts/measure-hosted-performance.mjs hardcodes page.goto(new URL('./', baseUrl)) and #setupThemeToggleBtn
git show 1cfc8774:scripts/measure-hosted-performance.mjs proves the retained diagnostic formerly targeted game.html and #themeToggleBtn
docs/performance/GAME_SHELL_DIAGNOSTIC.json is still blocked at desktop 3280ms/.4271 and mobile 2780ms/.2419 but is bound to pre-fix SHA 1cfc8774
public/app.js init() starts the tutorial/beta dynamic imports only after await loadCoreDashboard(), queueStartupHydration(), and several synchronous render steps
test/tutorial-layout-stability.test.js asserts CSS source text only; it does not observe rendered layout shift
items.constraint: Keep `/` as the canonical release Web Vitals authority and `game.html` as a clearly labeled diagnostic. Preserve lazy module boundaries; begin the first-run imports earlier without converting them to static boot imports or delaying dashboard authority. No fabricated performance values.
verification: route-specific CLI options deterministically select / versus /game.html, the matching interaction selector, output and boundary text
focused tests cover route normalization and reject unsafe/cross-origin route input
staging /game.html is measured on desktop and mobile after the exact candidate deploy, with real LCP/INP/CLS and shift sources retained
dark/light desktop/mobile tutorial captures are inspected and the canonical / receipt remains independently green

L1.recipe: Add a safe --route option and route-specific interaction selector/output contract to measure-hosted-performance.mjs so /game.html can be reproduced without editing the script.

L2.recipe: L1 plus start the tutorial/beta dynamic import promise in parallel with core-dashboard loading, retain lazy-module boundaries, add focused source/argument tests, and generate separate canonical-entry and game-shell staging receipts at desktop/mobile.

L3.recipe: L2 plus capture dark/light desktop/mobile first-run tutorial images, inspect the rendered pixels, and if either game-shell LCP/CLS bar remains red, use the captured shift/LCP attribution to root-fix and remeasure before promotion.

items.title: Make stable staging a machine-enforced prerequisite for production publication
items.premise: The Pages workflow publishes the Cloudflare production project inside its push-triggered build job. Session 84 therefore reached production at SHA 31248786 even though stable staging and all staging-bound receipts stayed at 8b7d5959. The workflow has no candidate revision input, no stable-staging provenance check, and no separation between build-on-push and promote-to-production.
evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml triggers on pushes touching public/src/package/workflow files and unconditionally runs Wrangler against project franchise-architect-football
Deploy Pages run 31679800654 succeeded for S84 SHA 31248786 and verify-live-origin reported production at that SHA
live production _health reports 31248786 / fc1dcf64 while live stable staging reports 8b7d5959 / 0f79737d
context/PROJECT_STATUS.json still says no deploy occurred and keeps staging/performance/release authority bound to 8b7d5959
docs/SESSION_PROTOCOL.md and CANON-007 require stable staging verification before production promotion
items.constraint: Do not force-push, flip launch status, weaken CI, or require a new paid service. Normal pushes may build/test artifacts, but production mutation must be explicit and must fail closed unless stable staging proves the same candidate revision and artifact digest.
verification: workflow source tests prove the production Wrangler and GitHub Pages deploy jobs are promotion-only
promotion inputs carry the exact candidate revision and staging artifact digest
a pre-promotion step verifies stable staging provenance against the locally built manifest and fails on revision/artifact drift
the exact S85 candidate is deployed to stable staging and verified before any production workflow is dispatched

L1.recipe: Condition production publish/deploy steps on an explicit workflow_dispatch boolean so ordinary pushes cannot mutate production.

L2.recipe: L1 plus require candidate revision and staging artifact digest inputs, checkout that exact SHA, verify the built manifest and live stable-staging receipt match both inputs, then publish and verify production. Add focused workflow-contract tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus emit a machine-readable promotion receipt artifact containing candidate, staging deployment, production verification and rollback identity for closeout reconciliation.

items.title: Fail visibly when checked-in release authority drifts behind Git or live origins
items.premise: The local doctor reports zero blocking failures and only lifecycle drift even though checked-in releaseAuthority says verified at 8b7d5959, production is live at 31248786, staging is still 8b7d5959, and current main is f2fda328. A session can therefore render a green historical authority object and a false 'no deploy' narrative after deployment has changed reality.
evidence: node scripts/ops.mjs doctor --json reports blockingFailing 0 and only lifecycle-authoritative-registry
context/PROJECT_STATUS.json releaseAuthority.status is verified at source/publication 8b7d5959
live staging, live production and git HEAD currently expose three distinct source revisions
Session 84 PROJECT_STATUS currentFocus/lastVerification says no deploy was required or performed, contradicted by successful Deploy Pages run 31679800654
items.constraint: The probe observes and classifies; it never deploys or rewrites authority by itself. Network failure is unknown/degraded, not green. Historical verified evidence remains valid as history but must not be described as current when identities diverge.
verification: pure evaluation tests cover current, staging-behind, production-behind, local-status-stale and network-unknown states
CLI JSON names HEAD, checked-in staging/release identities, live staging and live production identities without exposing secrets
doctor surfaces a non-blocking warning for evidence drift and a blocking failure only when a current-release claim is made from contradictory identities
Session 85 status prose is reconciled to actual deployment history and preserves launchReady false

L1.recipe: Add a read-only script that compares Git HEAD and checked-in release identities with live staging/production _health revisions and prints JSON drift.

L2.recipe: L1 plus pure classification tests, honest unknown handling, and integration into the local doctor so stale release evidence cannot remain silent.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a hash-bound reconciliation command that accepts verified staging/production/visual/performance receipts and updates status through write-project-status without ever manufacturing missing gates.

innovationCandidates.novelty: Turns a deployment workflow into a candidate-bound evidence producer rather than a fire-and-forget mutation.
Compares four independent authorities and distinguishes intentionally staged divergence from stale or contradictory release claims.
No real cohort signal justifies adding another system while first-run and release proof are stale.
